final: SELECT SUM(group_count), AVG(group_count - overall_avg) FROM (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(side_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS side_count FROM riskandmargin AS r2 JOIN orders AS o2 ON r2.ordervault = o2.recordvault GROUP BY o2.dealedge)))
